# Tranche review — tranche 4 (2026-11-26)

The end-of-tranche review of tranche 4 (`01a1e9e0-f4c0-727d-9afb-bb5b1e9783ce`), decided
`continue` on the evidence below. The decision closes tranche 4 and authorises tranche 5
(`01a1e9e0-fe45-77e0-993a-d571fecc5ec1`).

## Evidence

- **Ten members, ten green receipts at `18276de5`**: S05, S07, S09, T10, T16, T4, T9, T18, T19 and
  T14, zero failures each (`docs/evidence/rework/<key>.json`).
- **Programme baselines:** the management, governance and boundary baselines
  (`01a1fba9-308c-7cde-9d00-edb7f483f3af`, `01a1fba9-9afd-72e3-b41b-dc4287153c35`,
  `01a1fba9-d095-757c-91ed-afd21ecfa960`), approved.
- **T14's live gate, executed 2026-11-26:** six published toolkits each probed and called on the
  live estate — speech, transcription, coding, image_gen, scientific and retrieval — plus the
  scientific_processor scale-up/scale-back receipt, the zero-use report and the outage-unbind
  receipt (`docs/evidence/t14/live-gate.md`). Finding `v1-w3c-2` is resolved at `e8bb527d1`.
- **Cadences:** the tranche-4 PI plan (`01a202a1-dbb9-7e49-b64a-cf97c3fab095`), the refinement
  cadence (`01a202a2-2705-7392-a2d1-03ca2b3a174e`), the demo cadence
  (`01a202a1-f4ee-7acc-8e57-50ac6f0417fd`) and the retro cadence
  (`01a202a2-0e3f-75be-9f2b-c572ddcdfce9`); the tranche-4 PI plan and PI objectives documents are
  published.

## Benefit status

Seven benefit profiles (B1–B7): six active and measured, B3 in draft pending T6's approved
baseline — the status recorded at the tranche-3 review and unchanged in substance. The tranche's
own benefit is the rework evidence now green.

## Risk and issue register

The ten members carry 22 open risks in the register; the programme rows carry no overdue review.
The open issues are the members that stay active (T14 by its acceptance manifest; S05, S09 and T18
carry their next outputs), issue 561 (research and Lean toolkits, first wave, open) and the
retrieval corpus (this tenant has no indexed leaves, so `retrieval.query` answers zero hits).

## Decision

**Continue.** Tranche 4 is closed; tranche 5 is authorised. Conditions: T14 stays active; the
members that remain active carry their named next outputs; the retrieval corpus stays empty until a
tenant indexes leaves; tranche 5's packs are authored in tranche order.
title: Tranche review — tranche 4 (2026-11-26)
